SpecialTaxType.description: Product: QBO Description: Used for Zero rates for EC VAT. How it is used: VAT registered Businesses who receive goods/services (acquisitions) from other EU countries, will need to calculate the VAT due, but not paid, on these acquisitions. The rate of VAT payable is the same that would have been paid if the goods had been supplied by a UK supplier.
